cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Remember Me Correctly
cards.instruction: Create small tests of whether someone remembers your preferences, stories, or shared history.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're reading things out, so I've got a question for the table too. Which cup do I use every morning?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm reading the brunch menu. Just take a cup; everyone's hungry.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, breakfast questions. Twelve years you've made tea for me. Which cup?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The blue one. Your name's underneath.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Correct. Put it down and tell me how much milk. That isn't written underneath.
